text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Through fire and through sand!
If there's a voice crying out for help,
I'll rush there no matter where it is!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Justice Biko enters the dirt races!
Arriving at the February Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, torrential rain~!?
Running through sloshing mud is way too much of a disadvantage, no matter how you look at it~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come race day... it was unexpectedly pouring rain. Even so, the challenger
Biko Pegasus was welcomed with roaring cheers.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Biko! But the one winning today
is gonna be Windy-chan, nanoda~!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Shinko Windy!
Show 'em what you've got, put on a great show for us today too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm expecting big things from you!
What kind of surprise are you gonna show us!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaah! Windy-chan isn't gonna do anything weird!
That's totally not the kind of expectation I wanted!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it, Windy-senpai!
More importantly... let's go!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll hit 'em with my special move, the Pegasus Rapid Arrow, in the race!
Just try and block it if you can!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mgggh... Was that the late-stage kick
she showed me back on Valentine's Day...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I won't let you pass, I won't let you pass, nod! Windy-chan gets covered in mud and gives it her all every single day, nod!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, the dirt division is heating up
just as much as "the other side"!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That side's getting attention, but we're not falling behind either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“The other side”... Yes, the same week.
At last, that Umamusume in the center of the storm is making her move too.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here stands Narita Brian
upon the turf for the first time this year.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What kind of race will they show us?
And using this as a stepping stone, will their sights first
be set on the 2000m GⅠ, the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see, Brian-san is finally
running her first race of the year!
Even though we won't be racing together directly...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy-senpai! Today is also a match against Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: With Brian? Why is that, exactly???

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the kids are really looking forward to seeing which race will be more amazing.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san is certainly amazing. But
there are two of us. If we give it our double power—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We can run an even more amazing race than them!
Let's show them that today!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oho, just what I wanted! When Windy-chan gets serious, she can do anything!!"æµ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A showdown against the dirt powerhouse Shinko Windy.
And a clash for the spotlight against Narita Brian."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To win both battles. And to completely revamp Shinko Windy's reputation, Biko Pegasus charges forward.
